# Synthetic label fixtures

Generated by `scripts/qa/generate-shipping-label-fixtures.mjs`. These are real
GIF/PDF files containing only synthetic orientation markers and barcode-like
bars, not live carrier labels or scannable shipment identifiers.

- `portrait.gif` and `portrait.pdf`: upright 4:6 geometry.
- `landscape-left.gif` and `original-sideways.pdf`: text turned counterclockwise;
  the PDF has a 432×288 pt MediaBox/CropBox and zero `/Rotate`.
- `rotated-metadata.pdf`: separate example of `/Rotate=90` (not the current UPS
  source format; supplied to distinguish pixel orientation from PDF metadata).
- `unsupported.gif`: 4:7 geometry, rejected for automatic 4×6 output.

The renderer tests compare decoded pixels exactly, including bar widths and
spacing. Derived PDFs have 288×432 pt boxes and zero rotation. No production
artifact was accessed; the reported live file must still be checked in DEV.
